comentarios: Recorded from trail near flooded stream margin thicket in terra firma forest.  Bird stayed less than 1/2 meter from the ground and water surface and sang continuously from different positions.  Video available of bird and habitat.  iPhone playback used to draw out of thicket and was able to view clearly with binoculars though briefly as it moved through vegetation.  Used recording in Helm Field Guide app, 'All Birds Columbia' to identify voice and the field guide book 'Birds of South America: Passerines, by Ber van Perlo' for visual ID.
